description: This file defines the TemplateTableConfigResolver class, which configures and manages the notification template table in the application, including fetching data, handling actions, and dialog interactions.

classes.name: TemplateTableConfigResolver
classes.description: A resolver class that provides configuration for the notification template table, including data fetching, actions, and dialog management.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Returns the configured EntityTableConfig for NotificationTemplate.

methods.name: configureCellActions
methods.description: Sets up cell action descriptors, such as copy template action.

methods.name: editTemplate
methods.description: Handles editing or copying a notification template, opening the dialog and updating data upon completion.

methods.name: notificationTemplateDialog
methods.description: Opens a dialog for creating or editing a notification template and returns an observable of the result.
